actions.reason: C0001 has coherent, strongly significant WXS/CNV identity evidence centered on the VHL/PBRM1-altered 3p-loss axis, cross-modal membership support with strong WXS boundary separation, no significant technical confounder association, and no structural evidence indicating subdivision or insufficient separation. Retained as a defensible discovery-stage candidate for downstream validation.

C0002 shows a coherent SETD2/PTEN-altered, metabolically down-regulated identity with the highest cross-modal membership support and strong WXS boundary separation, no technical confounder association, and no structural evidence of subdivision or insufficient separation. Retained for downstream validation.

C0003 has a coherent BAP1-mutant/PBRM1-wildtype identity with immune-inflammatory RNA upregulation, moderate cross-modal support and strong WXS boundary separation, no technical confounder association, and no structural evidence indicating subdivision or insufficient separation. Retained for downstream validation.

C0004 has a coherent VHL-mutant/PBRM1-wildtype mutation identity with strong WXS boundary separation from all other sets, no technical confounder association, and no structural evidence of subdivision or insufficient separation. Although cross-modal corroboration is WXS-dominant, this does not undermine the defensible discovery-stage candidate.

C0005 has a coherent VHL/PBRM1-wildtype mutation identity with strong WXS boundary separation from all other sets, no technical confounder association, and no structural evidence of subdivision or insufficient separation. WXS-dominant cross-modal support does not preclude retaining this defensible discovery-stage candidate.
